verdict.rationale: Yapily is API-first. Its Data, Payments, Authorisations and Webhook APIs are documented and generated from a published OpenAPI v3 spec, which Yapily says it uses itself for its server-side libraries. The docs say to use the direct API when you need payment types the Hosted UI does not yet support (bulk, scheduled, periodic, international), so the API goes beyond its pre-built UI. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that console/dashboard admin functions (app setup, credentials, configuration) are exposed via API, and independent corroboration; the OpenAPI file was also not found at the probed docs paths.
